notes: Vultr Agent Rush entry on a short deadline. The full test suite takes about 3.5 minutes, so don't run it under a tight timeout. Harness updates come from a local copy of the package outside this repo; see .harness/harness.lock.json for the installed release. Owner's review decision (2026-11-06): instead of full strict review, run one time-boxed independent Codex review each for the verdict logic (M3), the sandbox (M4) and the public app (M5-M6). Only serious findings block; list what stays open. If time is tight, fall back to the implementing agent's own review and say so. M3 was reviewed by two fresh independent agents because Codex usage was exhausted; fresh agents are an acceptable reviewer when Codex is unavailable.
